en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. Abi (rah) and Muhammad b. al-Hassan they said it was narrated to us by Muhammad b. Yahya and Ahmad b. Idrisall of themfrom Muhammad b. Ahmad from Yahya b. ’Imran from al-Sayyari from Abi Abdillah Muhammad b. Ahmad from Yunis b. Ya’qub from al-Sadiq (a.s.) who said: “
One who applies perfume at the start of the day while fasting, his intelligence won’t decrease.”
